resources.lifecycle: Arm one strict-cadence timer; tick aborts logical predecessor and increments sequence; fetch then consume body; stop clears timer/controller and is terminal. Restart requires fresh region/context. Underlying SubmitFetch request/body ownership is external.
invariants: No superseded or stopped result paints (sequence/stopped guard exists). Current context/logout/alive must remain admitted through body completion. Logical cancellation must not be described as physical one-inflight without supported transport cancellation.
failure_scenarios: Headers pass context A; body suspends; context changes to B without tick/stop; body settles: only stopped/sequence checked, old body reaches delivery callback (actual DOM rendering requires caller hook).
Repeated ticks reject adapter promise but injected fetch receives no signal; never-settling physical requests can coexist. Abort listener is once and removed on settlement; no listener leak inferred.
gaps: LC01: post-body context/logout/alive/visibility admission gap.
LC02: AbortSignal adapter suppresses result but does not stop SubmitFetch transport; controller cleared before body consumption.
resources.disposition: Retain existing policy; narrow repair/qualification proposed, implementation deferred.

resources.owner: UI document registry, binders and listener leases
resources.lifecycle: One client per document WeakMap; global listeners + known-selector binders; rescan releases disconnected elements; stop should release swap hook, global/element listeners and registry. No persisted restart state.
invariants: Start/rescan/stop must not strand successfully acquired leases on callback failure; disposal remains total/idempotent and preserves first failure.
Current fixed binder selectors restrict registration; source uses three known cores, not arbitrary selector discovery.
failure_scenarios: Replace a known core binder with throwing binder: initial rescan throws after registry/global registration; next start returns partial client (manual stop still possible).
Swap release throws after stopped=true: remaining listeners/binders/registry not cleared and second stop no-ops.
gaps: LC03: acquisition rollback/total teardown absent for structural callback failure; ordinary DOM callbacks not claimed failing.
resources.disposition: Retain existing policy; narrow repair/qualification proposed, implementation deferred.

resources.lifecycle: Attach click guard + can:settled listener; set inflight/disabled; settled event clears; binder release removes listeners.

failure_scenarios: No can:settled producer found in package source: supported consumer may leave control inflight after failed/completed action. Disabled button prevents ordinary repeat; anchors/custom controls require own semantics.
gaps: LC04: completion producer/markup join unresolved; no mounted double-submit incident asserted.
resources.stage: browser helper; actual completion join unproved
resources.disposition: Retain existing policy; narrow repair/qualification proposed, implementation deferred.

resources.owner: UI form operation and upload progress

invariants: First validation failure precedes corresponding effect; partial uploaded files are separate effects.
Retry same operation must reuse frozen completed upload identities or reconcile receipt; transport failure does not prove mutation absent.
Header/body errors should follow declared error mapping; byte/time/cancel ownership needs real host policy.
failure_scenarios: File FA finalizes then later upload fails: retry mints FB and FA has no client cleanup/progress recovery.
Mutation commits FA but reply lost; retry same operation with freshly uploaded FB has changed inputs and can conflict instead of recovering original receipt.
response.text rejects outside fetch catch in postJson/mutation path: declared transport mapping bypassed.
gaps: LC05: retry/progress ownership missing at helper seam.
LC06: body-read failure mapping and cancellation/deadline ownership incomplete.

Lost response after rows 1..k commit: preserved same per-row IDs permit replay; changed values require conflict, not duplicate effects.
gaps: Existing data/protocol findings reused; no new duplicate obligation.
No durable preview disposal/cancel/row progress owner demonstrated by this helper.
resources.disposition: Retain existing policy; narrow repair/qualification proposed, implementation deferred.

resources.owner: Interfaces incoming body reader and capped buffer
resources.lifecycle: Acquire reader; check cumulative cap before retaining next chunk; overflow cancel then throw limit; finally release lock; null body empty. Buffer lifetime ends with request processing.
invariants: Cap retained bytes and release lock on done/read failure/overflow.
Byte cap is not a deadline; arbitrary reader cancellation/read promises require host liveness policy.
failure_scenarios: Custom stream cancel never settles: overflow awaits cancellation before finally, lock/error completion remain pending.
Read rejection runs finally release; normal oversize cancellation rejection is swallowed then limit error retained (positive controls).
gaps: LC07: bounded reader/cancel deadline is a host qualification decision, not evidence standard Request cancellation hangs.
resources.disposition: Retain existing policy; narrow repair/qualification proposed, implementation deferred.

resources.owner: Interfaces verified ingress and durable intake handoff
